title: P@x model list
description: The providers P@x can use, the models offered for each, and their prices. Read from /etc/tur/pax/models.json if it exists, else /usr/share/tur/pax/models.json; never written by P@x. Model names and prices are configuration, never compiled in (ADR-0004). A model the person types that is not listed is accepted; its price is then not known and P@x limits it in tokens. The loader in services/tur-pax (settings.rs) is authoritative and also enforces: a provider is listed once; a model name is listed once per provider, with no control characters and no surrounding whitespace; prices follow the rules of the provider configuration (finite, not negative, a currency of 1 to 8 letters).

status.description: example: figures read on one day to show the format, not kept up to date. maintained: a list its publisher keeps up to date.

prices_as_of.description: The day the prices were read.

data_terms_url.description: Where the provider says how it handles data sent to its interface. Shown with the consent text.

key_url.description: Where a person gets a key.

max_output_tokens.description: P@x's own limit for one response with this model.

tested_with_tur.description: Whether the project ran its conformance tests against this model.

prices.description: Per million tokens. Absent when the price is not known or cannot be stated in this form.
